x: This event has shown a revival in popularity this season, and with more practice and attention to style and technique, Frank Watson, a new member, Bert Machell and our Field Events' Captain, should show some good performances.
Charlie Jones was our best performer but Bert Machell and Geoff. Freestone have possibilities, and Frank Norman has started to train for this event.

"Steve" Gibson, Les Christmas and Stan Botwright will be our main hopes in the Long Jump, but it would be good to see Geoff Wood taking part in this event more often as it is felt he has good possibilities. Geoff Wood and Les Christmas, together with Bert Machell, will be our Hop, Step and Jump men.
